name: Virgin Komi Forests
description: In the northern Ural Mountains of Russia's Komi Republic, this protected wilderness covers about 32,800 square kilometres, making it Europe's largest virgin forest. Dark conifer taiga, birch and aspen stands, peat bogs, rivers and lakes roll toward the open tundra of the mountain slopes. Scientists have studied it for over fifty years to see how an untouched northern forest works.
